description: Ireland: which income tax return to file. Form 11 (self-assessment, ROS) if taxable non-PAYE income is more than EUR 5,000, gross non-PAYE income is more than EUR 30,000, you hold more than 15% of a company as a proprietary director, a trade made nil profit or a loss, or you provide childcare services; otherwise Form 12 in myAccount for small non-PAYE income or to claim refunds; with the deadline.
